blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
The integration of deep learning models into image preprocessing pipelines such as super-resolution introduces a largely unexplored attack vector for adversaries targeting downstream tasks.
To ensure trustworthiness of critical imaging pipelines, we must be able to detect adversarial behavior within preprocessing models.
In this paper, we propose a spectral-based detection method for identifying adversarial attacks embedded in super-resolution model weights.
More specifically, we use the radially-averaged power spectral density as a discriminative feature to train an extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) detector, demonstrating detectability of model-level threats in super-resolution networks.
We further benchmark our detector against magnitude- and phase-based Fourier spectrum detectors, evaluating each method across a range of training and cross-architecture scenarios.
Our proposed detector out-performs the comparison detectors in most of these scenarios and indicates that high-frequency features are most informative for detecting AdvSR attacks across SR architectures.
blocks.zh:
将深层学习模型整合到超分辨率等图像预处理管道中,引入了针对下游任务的对手基本上未探索的攻击矢量.
为了确保关键成像管道的可信赖性,我们必须能够发现预处理模型中的对抗行为.
在本文中,我们提出了一种基于光谱的检测方法,用于识别嵌入在超分辨率模型权重中的对抗攻击.
更具体地说,我们利用射线平均功率光谱密度作为一种区分特征,来训练一种极端梯度增强(XGBooost)探测器,显示了模型级威胁在超分辨率网络中的可探测性.
我们进一步将我们的探测器与基于大小和相位的傅里叶频谱探测器作为基准,在一系列培训和跨结构的假设中评价每一种方法。
我们提议的探测器在大多数这些情景中都超越了比较探测器,并表明高频特性对于检测整个SR架构的AdvSR攻击最具有信息性.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Preprocessing pipelines are essential for state-of-the-art quality in downstream computer vision tasks, such as detection and classification [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . However, the incorporation of deep learning models into preprocessing pipelines introduces a stealthy attack vector for adversaries targeting downstream tasks. To ensure trustworthiness of imaging pipelines, it is essential to design methods to detect adversarial behavior in preprocessing models.
blocks.zh: 预处理管道对于下游计算机视觉任务(如检测和分类[1,2,3])的先进质量至关重要. 然而,将深层学习模型纳入预处理管道,为对手瞄准下游任务引入了隐形攻击矢量. 为了确保成像管道的可信赖性,必须设计出检测预处理模型中对抗行为的方法.

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Example of AdvSR attacks for SRCNN, EDSR, and SwinIR architectures targeting misclassification of “war planes” to “trailer trucks” for YOLOv11. These attacks preserve image quality while causing misclassification with high confidence.
blocks.zh: 费格。 1: AdvSR攻击SRCNN、EDSR和SwinIR架构的例子,目标是将YOLOv11的“作战飞机”错误分类为“拖车”。 这些攻击保持了图像质量,同时引起高度自信的错分类.

blocks.en:
In our previous work, we constructed a targeted adversarial attack embedded within the weights of a super-resolution model [ 4 , 5 ] . The resulting adversarial super-resolution (AdvSR) models produce high-fidelity reconstructions, while causing targeted misclassification. We showed successful attacks using three distinct super-resolution architectures: SRCNN [ 6 ] , EDSR [ 7 ] , and SwinIR [ 8 ] .
Since then, we refined the attack to be effective for classifiers with more classes, less perceptible to the human eye, and adaptable to any input image size [ 9 ] . Figure 1 provides an example of the improved AdvSR attack targeting misclassification of “war planes” to “trailer trucks” for YOLOv11 [ 10 , 11 ] .
While our previous work explored AdvSR’s viability as an attack vector, we have yet to explore the detectability of this attack.
blocks.zh:
在我们之前的作品中,我们构建了一种目标明确的对抗攻击,它嵌入了超分辨率模型的重量[4,5]. 由此形成的对抗性超解(AdvSR)模型产生高可靠性重建,同时导致定向错误分类. 我们使用三种独特的超分辨率结构进行了成功的攻击:SRCNN [6],EDSR [7],和SwinIR [8]。
从此,我们精炼了攻击效果,使分类器具有更多的等级,对人眼不太能辨识,并且适应任何输入图像大小[9]. 图1举例说明了AdvSR针对YOLOv11 [10, 11]的“作战飞机”误分类为“拖车”的改进攻击。
虽然我们以前的工作探索了AdvSR作为攻击载体的可行性,但我们还没有探索这次攻击的可探测性.

blocks.en:
In this paper, we propose a novel spectral-based detector and evaluate its performance on AdvSR attacks.
This detector exploits an image’s radially-averaged power spectral density (PSD) as a discriminative feature for detecting AdvSR attacks. We compare our approach to existing spectral approaches and demonstrate better performance in the majority of test cases.
We also examine the explainability of our proposed method and identify that AdvSR attacks inject most adversarial content into high spatial frequencies.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出一个新的基于光谱的探测器,并评价其对AdvSR攻击的性能.
这种探测器利用图像的辐射平均功率光谱密度(PSD)作为发现AdvSR攻击的歧视性特征。 我们比较了我们与现有光谱方法的方法,并在大多数试验中表现出更好的性能。
我们还审查我们拟议方法的可解释性,并查明AdvSR攻击将大多数对抗性内容注入高空间频率。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Detection methods for adversarial attacks apply a variety of techniques to detect malicious images from clean images.
Local Intrinsic Dimensionality (LID) [ 12 ] focuses on identifying adversarial subspaces through increased dimensionality, while deep Mahalanobis detectors [ 13 ] employ the Mahalanobis distance to identify out-of-distribution samples.
Squeezing methods like [ 14 , 15 ] compress image feature spaces and use the level of compression to detect attacks.
Among spectral approaches, SpectralDefense [ 16 ] introduces four frequency-domain detectors. These detectors apply logistic regression to the magnitude or phase of the Fourier spectrum computed from either the input image or internal layer activations of the classification model. Collectively, these methods demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across five standard attacks, including FGSM [ 17 ] and Carlini & Wagner [ 18 ] . However, these standard attacks have been shown to alter features in medium frequency bands [ 19 ] , while super-resolution methods alter high-frequency content by design. Thus a successful AdvSR detector must distinguish between genuine and malicious high-frequency content.
blocks.zh:
对抗性攻击的侦测方法应用各种技术从干净的图像中检测恶意图像.
局部内在维度(LID)[12]侧重于通过增强维度来识别对抗性亚空间,而深马哈拉诺比斯探测器[13]则使用马哈拉诺比斯距离来识别分布外样本.
挤压方法如[14,15]压缩图像特征空间,并使用压缩水平来检测攻击.
在光谱方法中,光谱防御[16]引入了四个频率域探测器. 这些探测器将后勤回归应用于Fourier频谱的大小或相位,从分类模型的输入图像或内部层激活计算出来。 这些方法集体展示了包括FGSM[17]和Carlini & Wagner[18]在内的五起标准攻击中的最新性能. 然而,这些标准攻击已被证明会改变中频段的特征[19],而超分辨率方法则通过设计改变高频内容. 因此,成功的AdvSR探测器必须区分真实和恶意的高频含量。

blocks.en:
Moreover, many of the aforementioned detectors require white-box access to the classifier model to function. This limits their applicability in practice, where this access may be unavailable.
Instead, our proposed method uses only spectral features of the SR image and does not require access to the downstream image classifier, its weights, or its internal activations.
We compare our proposed approach with two other image-only detectors, InputMFS and InputPFS [ 16 ] , which generally outperformed LID and Mahalanobis distance.
This enables a direct comparison of image-level spectral features for detecting AdvSR attacks.
blocks.zh:
此外,上述许多探测器需要白箱进入分类器模型才能发挥作用。 这限制了它们在实践中的适用性,如果可能无法使用。
相反,我们提议的方法只使用SR图像的光谱特征,并不要求访问下游图像分类器,其权重或内部激活.
我们把我们提议的方法与另外两个只显示图像的探测器(InvolutionMFS和InvolutPFS[16])进行比较,它们一般表现超过LID和Mahalanobis距离.
这样可以直接比较图像级光谱特征,以检测AdvSR攻击.

blocks.en: III Proposed Method
blocks.zh: 三 拟议方法

blocks.en:
For each super-resolved image, we first compute a single-channel luminance image, x x , and then calculate its 2D Fourier transform, shifted so that the zero-frequency component lies at the center. Let X ⁡ ( u , v ) X(u,v) be the resulting spectrum and P ⁡ ( u , v ) = | X ⁡ ( u , v ) | 2 P(u,v)=|X(u,v)|^{2} its power spectrum.
Next, we group the spectral coefficients into bins based on their normalized radial distance from the center and average the coefficients within each bin.
The resulting radially-averaged power spectral density (PSD) for the k k th bin spanning radial distance [ r k , r k + 1 ) ⊆ [ 0 , 1 ] [r_{k},r_{k+1})\subseteq[0,1] is given by PSD ⁡ ( r k ) = 1 | S k | ​ ∑ ( u , v ) ∈ S k P ⁡ ( u , v ) \operatorname{PSD}(r_{k})=\frac{1}{|S_{k}|}\sum_{(u,v)\in S_{k}}P(u,v) (1) where S k S_{k} is the set of frequencies ( u , v ) (u,v) in the k k th bin and | S k | |S_{k}| denotes the number of elements in that set.

We use PSD ⁡ ( r k ) \operatorname{PSD}(r_{k}) with 256 frequency bins as an input feature vector for our detector.
By inputting the radially-averaged PSD, we ensure that all frequencies across the image spectrum are included for analysis while also compressing features through radial averaging.
We provide this vector to an extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) [ 20 ] classifier, which predicts whether the image was generated by a clean or adversarial super-resolution model.
We select XGBoost for its speed and innate explainability.
blocks.zh:
我们使用 PSD QQ( r k )\ operatorname{ PSD}( r_{k ) , 使用256个频率插件作为我们探测器的输入特性矢量 。
通过输入射线平均值的私营部门司,我们确保将图像频谱的所有频率都包括在内进行分析,同时通过射线平均值压缩特征。
我们为这个向量提供极端梯度提升(XGBooost)[20]分级器,它预测图像是由干净的还是对抗的超分辨率模型生成的.
我们选择 XGBoost 的速度和内在的解释性。

blocks.en: IV Experimental Data and Results
blocks.zh: 四. 实验数据和结果

blocks.en: In this section, we detail training procedures, report experimental results, and discuss explainability of our proposed method and its implications.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们详细介绍培训程序,报告实验结果,并讨论我们拟议方法的可解释性及其影响。

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Pipeline for training and testing detection methods. We apply clean and adversarial super-resolvers to LR images, apply feature extractors to the resulting SR images, and input these features to detectors for both training and testing.
blocks.zh: 费格。 2:用于培训和测试检测方法的管道。 我们在LR图像上应用干净和对抗性的超解器,在生成的SR图像上应用特征提取器,并将这些特性输入探测器进行训练和测试.

blocks.en: IV-A Training Details
blocks.zh: 培训详情

blocks.en:
For training and testing, we use a subset of ImageNet [ 21 ] containing vehicular classes such as sports car, tractor trailer, and war plane, as well as three non-vehicular dummy classes.
To assess the impact of classifier complexity on attack detectability, we construct a dataset from this subset containing 5 classes (ImageNet5).
These images are then split into training, validation, and testing sets with distinct training sets for the super-resolvers, YOLOv11 classifier, and XGBoost detector.
blocks.zh:
在训练和测试方面,我们使用ImageNet[21]的子集,包含运动车,拖拉机拖车,战机等车辆课,以及三个非车辆假人课.
为了评估分类复杂度对攻击可探测性的影响,我们从这个包含5类(ImageNet5)的子集中构建了一个数据集.
然后将这些图像分为训练、验证和测试组,对超级溶解器、YOLOv11分类器和XGBoost探测器有不同的训练组。

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows the procedure used for detector training and testing. We input LR images into both clean and AdvSR models to produce SR images. These are then labeled as 0 for clean and 1 for adversarial. All detectors (including comparison methods) receive the same clean and adversarial training images. Then we extract spectral features from the super-resolved images, which are the radially-averaged PSD for our approach and magnitude and/or phase of the Fourier spectrum for InputMFS and InputPFS. Finally, we use the extracted features to train the detectors.
blocks.zh: 图2显示了用于探测器培训和测试的程序。 我们把 LR 图像输入到 干净和 AdvSR 模型中来生成 SR 图像. 然后标注为干净的0,对抗的1。 所有探测器(包括比较方法)都得到同样的清洁和对抗训练图像. 然后,我们从超解成的图像中提取光谱特征,这些图像是我们对输入式MFS和输入式PFS方法、规模和(或)Fourier光谱的光谱平均值。 最后,我们用提取的特性来训练探测器.

blocks.en: IV-B Detector Results
blocks.zh: 四-B 检测结果

blocks.en:
We train individual detectors on SRCNN, EDSR, and SwinIR architectures respectively.
Additionally, we jointly train on two architectures and test on the unseen architecture (“leave-one-out”), as well as train a unified detector on all three architectures. We evaluate all detectors on the same testing images at inference time.
Unless specified, we test all detectors on their trained AdvSR architectures.
We assess performance across all detectors using accuracy (Acc), F1 score (F1) and area under the curve (AUC).
blocks.zh:
我们分别在SRCNN,EDSR和SwinIR架构上培训个人探测器.
此外,我们联合对两个建筑进行训练,并对看不见的建筑进行试验(“leave-One-out”),并对所有三个建筑进行统一的探测器训练。 我们在推断时间 在同一测试图像上评估所有探测器
除非具体说明,我们测试所有探测器 在他们训练的AdvSR架构。
我们利用精确度(Acc),F1分(F1)和曲线下的区域(AUC)来评估所有探测器的性能.

blocks.en: TABLE I: Detector performance across SR architectures. Each detector is trained and tested using outputs from the same SR architecture. The best result for each architecture and metric is shown in bold.
blocks.zh: 表格 I:检测器在SR架构中的性能. 每个探测器都使用同一SR架构的输出进行训练和测试. 每个架构和计量的最佳结果以粗体表示。

blocks.en:
In Table I , we directly compare the proposed radially-averaged PSD detector with InputMFS and InputPFS when the detectors are trained and tested on the same SR architecture. Our proposed detector achieves the highest accuracy, F1 score, and ROC-AUC for EDSR and SwinIR, while InputMFS performs best for SRCNN. Averaged across the three architectures, the proposed detector obtains an F1 score of 0.924 and ROC-AUC of 0.973, compared with 0.898 and 0.962 for InputMFS and 0.476 and 0.503 for InputPFS, respectively.
These results indicate that the radially-averaged PSD is a better discriminative feature for the AdvSR attack using complex SR architectures.
blocks.zh:
在表格中 我们直接将提议的辐射平均私营部门司探测器与输入式MFS和输入式PFS进行比较,当探测器在同一SR架构上接受训练和测试时。 我们提议的探测器达到了最高的精度,F1分,以及EDSR和SwinIR的ROC-AUC,而投入MFS对SRCNN的性能最好. 平均跨越三个架构,拟议的探测器获得的F1分数分别为0.924分和ROC-AUC分数分别为0.973分,而投入式MFS和投入式PFS分别为0.898分和0.962分和0.503分.
这些结果表明,光度平均的私营部门司是利用复杂的SR架构进行AdvSR攻击的更好的歧视特征。

blocks.en: TABLE II: Detector performance under leave-one-SR-model-out and unified training. The unified detectors are trained using all three SR architectures; “All SR” is their pooled test set. The best result for each test set and metric is shown in bold.
blocks.zh: 表格 二,在留学一SR模式和统一训练下进行探测器性能. 统一探测器使用所有三种SR架构进行训练;“所有SR”是其集合测试集。 每个测试集和度量的最佳结果以黑体表示。

blocks.en:
In Table II , we show the results for leave-one-out and unified approaches. On average, the proposed detector obtains a ROC-AUC of 0.833, compared with 0.760 for InputMFS and 0.493 for InputPFS. Its performance is strongest when EDSR or SwinIR is held out. However, when SRCNN is held out, InputMFS performs best and the proposed detector classifies every adversarial SRCNN output as clean.
We also assess the performance of a unified model for all detectors with performance similar to Table I across all detectors. The unified detector results on solely SRCNN test images suggest that SRCNN is not a consistent failure case for all models and rather reflects a correctable lapse in training data. As expected, the inclusion of more SR architectures and their spectral behavior in training improves the generalization of the detector. This discrepancy in performance across SR architectures motivates exploring the proposed detector’s explainability.
blocks.zh:
在表二中,我们列出了 " 一停 " 和统一办法的结果。 提议的探测器平均获得的ROC-AUC为0.833,而投入式MFS为0.760,投入式PFS为0.493。 当EDSR或SwinIR被牵出时其性能最强. 然而,当SRCNN被保持时,InformMFS的性能最好,拟议的探测器将每次对抗性的SRCNN输出都归类为干净.
我们还评估所有探测器上所有性能与表一相似的探测器的统一模型的性能。 仅在SRCNN测试图像上得出的统一检测结果表明,SRCNN并不是所有模型的一贯故障案例,而是反映了培训数据中可以纠正的失误. 如预期,在训练中加入更多的SR架构及其光谱行为,可以改善探测器的泛化. 整个SR架构的性能差异促使人们探索拟议的探测器的可解释性。

blocks.en: IV-C Detector Explainability
blocks.zh: 四-C 可探测性

blocks.en: Fig. 3: Normalized radially-averaged PSD for clean and adversarial SR outputs. Each spectrum is normalized by its DC bin before averaging. Solid curves show the mean, while the shaded regions indicate one standard deviation above and below the mean. The lower row shows the attacked-to-clean power ratio, where a ratio of one indicates no change.
blocks.zh: 图3:使私营部门司实现正常的射线平均,用于清洁和对抗性斯洛伐克共和国产出。 每个频谱在平均值之前通过DC bin实现正常化. 固体曲线显示平均值,而阴影区域则显示平均值上下的一个标准偏差. 下行显示攻击与清洁动力比,其中1比表示无变化.

blocks.en: In Figure 3 , we compare the normalized mean radially-averaged PSD of clean and adversarial outputs across 256 frequency bins for each SR architecture. The adversarial EDSR and SwinIR outputs exhibit a large increase in power at the highest radial frequencies. In contrast, the adversarial SRCNN outputs are actually lower than the clean outputs at most of these frequencies. This power mismatch between SRCNN and the other two examined architectures helps explain the discrepancies seen in Table II , as the attacked-to-clean power ratio increases sharply for EDSR and SwinIR. Without this increase in power, a detector trained on these architectures could reasonably infer that the input image was clean.
blocks.zh: 在图3中,我们比较了每个斯洛伐克共和国结构256个频率箱的清洁和对抗性产出的普通平均射线平均私营部门司。 对抗性的EDSR和SwinIR输出在最高射线频率的功率大增. 相比之下,对抗性的SRCNN输出实际上低于大多数这些频率的清洁输出. SRCNN和另外两个被检查的架构之间的这种动力不匹配有助于解释表二中看到的不匹配之处,因为EDSR和SwinIR受到攻击的对清洁的动力比急剧上升. 如果没有这种功率的增加,经过这些架构培训的探测器可以合理地推断输入图像是干净的.

blocks.en: Fig. 4: Shapley analysis of the proposed radially-averaged PSD detector across SR architectures. Feature color represents radial spectral power, while the horizontal Shapley value represents the contribution toward a clean or adversarial prediction.
blocks.zh: 费格。 4:对拟议的跨斯洛伐克共和国结构的放射平均私营部门司探测器进行精细分析。 地貌颜色代表光谱功率,而水平的沙普利值则代表对清洁或对抗性预测的贡献.

blocks.en: In Figure 4 , we further examine the frequency bins that drive the proposed detector’s predictions for each SR architecture, using Shapley values [ 22 ] . Positive Shapley values move a prediction toward the adversarial class, while negative values move it toward the clean class; the feature value indicates the radial spectral power observed in that bin. For EDSR and SwinIR, the largest absolute Shapley values are concentrated in the highest-frequency bins, indicating that the detector identifies these attacks primarily from changes near the upper end of the radial spectrum. For SRCNN, however, the influential features are distributed across a broader range of frequencies, suggesting that its attack modifies the spectral signature more diffusely. This aligns with the radially-averaged PSD results shown in Figure 3 . Notably, the results from AdvSR attacks on EDSR and SwinIR contrast with traditional adversarial attacks, such as Carlini&Wagner, which have been observed to predominately feature in mid-frequency bands [ 19 , 16 ] . A detector that evaluates features across low, mid, and high frequencies would likely then be the most robust to changes in SR models and attacks.
blocks.zh: 在图4中,我们进一步考察了驱动拟议检测器对每个SR架构的预测的频率箱,使用Shapley值[22]. 正切值将预测移向对抗类,而负值则将其移向清洁类;特征值则表示该桶中观测到的光谱功率. 对于EDSR和SwinIR来说,最大的绝对沙普利值集中在最高频率的宾箱中,表明探测器主要从射线谱的上端附近的变化中识别出这些攻击. 然而,对SRCNN来说,有影响力的特征分布在更广泛的频率范围内,表明其攻击能更分散地改变光谱特征. 这与图3所示的私营部门司的辐射平均结果一致。 值得注意的是,AdvSR攻击EDSR和SwinIR的结果与传统的对抗性攻击(如Carlini和Wagner)形成对比,后者主要表现在中频段[19,16]. 评估低频、中频和高频特征的探测器很可能对SR模型和攻击的变化最为有力。

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we demonstrate the detectability of AdvSR attacks using spectral features. Our developed detector generalizes across AdvSR models and produces superior metrics to comparison detectors in most testing scenarios. We additionally incorporate explainability to investigate where our detector falls short and why. Future work will use these results to improve the robustness of our detector and increase its generalizability to other SR architectures and model-weight attacks.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们用光谱特征演示了AdvSR攻击的可探测性. 我们所开发的探测器在AdvSR模型中泛泛而论,并在大多数测试情景中产生优于比较探测器的度量. 我们还增加了解释性,以调查我们的探测器不足之处和原因。 今后的工作将利用这些成果来提高我们的探测器的强度,并提高其对其他SR架构和模型重量攻击的普及性.
